lines.text: In the days of Jehoiakim, God sent Jeremiah to bring the Rechabites into the house of the LORD and offer them wine.
The Rechabites refused the wine because their forefather Jonadab commanded them never to drink it and to live in caves.
When Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, the Rechabites went into Jerusalem to escape the armies.
God said the words of Jonadab had been carried out, while He sent all His servants the priests to Judah again and again.
God said He would bring disaster on Judah, and He promised that Jonadab would never lack a man to stand before Him.
